title: spec-property-retirement playbook intro says eight generated artifacts where the AGENTS.md section it cites says six
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① documentation defect with a named producer, raised in the dev report 6814662463 of PR #32546 (#32520) and left to the seat by delta review 6814780862 ③. ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## The text

`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` on `main` (`2359ceadc`):

- L33-34: 「AGENTS.md §"Touched `packages/spec`?"(八个生成产物…)」 — the playbook says **eight** generated artifacts. `AGENTS.md` L652, the section it cites: "`packages/spec` has **six** checked-in generated artifacts".
- L29-31: a one-character line 「是」 splits the sentence 「…于是你得到的是 / 每个面一轮红构建…」 (a wrap artefact; the rule is intact).

## Reach

Every reader of the retirement playbook who counts the artifacts to regenerate against the cited AGENTS.md section. The file is at its line ceiling, so the fix pays in place.

## Duplicate check

No open card names either line.
